newsitem.title: USA: Dow solidly higher as market pessimism dissipates.
newsitem.headline: Dow solidly higher as market pessimism dissipates.

text.p: Wall Street stocks hovered slightly off their session highs in midafternoon activity on Wednesday, with the Dow holding solidly above the 7000 level.
The Dow industrials were up 64 points at 7026 and the Standard & Poor's 500 was eight higher at 802. Index-arbitrage trading curbs remained in effect on the New York Stock Exchange.

Analysts said the advance, which extended gains achieved during a near-record session for blue chips on Tuesday, was evidence that the mood on Wall Street, at least for now, has turned optimistic once again.
"This market is truly manic depressive," said Scott Bleier, chief investment strategist at Prime Charter Ltd. "We've gone from euphoria to despair and back to euphoria again."
The rally remained broad, with advancing issues holding to a two-to-one edge on active NYSE volume of about 385 million shares.
Technology stocks were sharply higher. The Nasdaq Composite jumped 19 points to 1261.
